#!/usr/bin/env bash
set -euo pipefail

SVC="{{service_name}}"
LOCAL={{local_port}}
REMOTE={{remote_port}}

while true; do
  echo "[$(date -Is)] forward svc/$SVC $LOCAL -> $REMOTE"
  kubectl port-forward "svc/$SVC" "$LOCAL:$REMOTE" || true
  echo "disconnected, retry in 2s"
  sleep 2
done
summary_zh: kubectl port-forward 自動重連保活
